Kill [[Justiciar Amilyn]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
Must have access to [[Lion's Arch Keep]], see [[:File:War in Kryta flow chart.png|flowchart]] for details.

===Objectives===
* Kill [[Justiciar Amilyn]] in [[Kessex Peak (War in Kryta)|Kessex Peak]]
* *BONUS* Kill Justiciar Amilyn in [[Hard Mode]]
* See [[Princess Salma]] for your reward

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 750 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 10 [[War Supplies]]
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 5 War Supplies

==Walkthrough==
The [[Temple of the Ages]] is the only outpost in Kryta that lets you form a party of eight, so you should start from there. Travel through [[The Black Curtain (War in Kryta)|The Black Curtain]] to Kessex Peak, killing various creatures and [[White Mantle]]/[[Peacekeeper]]s along the way. In Kessex Peak, follow the trail south-southwest, turning west at first opportunity, and you will eventually run into Amilyn. Kill her and then claim your reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Wanted by the Shining Blade
:''"The murderous warrior named Amilyn hides behind the title "Justiciar," but she is little more than a thug in white garb. Allies of Kryta who travel to Kessex Peak to dispose of this hoodlum will receive a royal bounty and the adulation of all Krytans who have had the misfortune of meeting her."''
;After completion of The Battle for Lion's Arch
:''"Re-create this classic event from the War in Kryta! The murderous warrior named Amilyn hid behind the title "Justiciar," but she was little more than a thug in white garb until bounty hunters ended her reign of terror during the war. Travel to Kessex Peak and dispose of this hoodlum to receive a royal bounty in this completely accurate historical reenactment."'''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'll do whatever I can to help restore order to Kryta.
| decline = War! What is it good for?
| ask = Justiciar Amilyn must pay for her countless acts of cruelty. Track her down in Kessex Peak. 
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Princess Salma
:''"Thank you <Character name>, your efforts bring us one step closer to a unified nation."''

==Notes==
* It is efficient to do this quest with [[Wanted: Destor the Truth Seeker]] and [[Wanted: Justiciar Marron]] for a total of 45 supplies in Hard Mode. These bosses are close to each other and their bounties are relatively close in the quest cycle. You still need to accept each quest on the day it's available.
